sample.task:
(As I walked across the desert biome, I began to wonder what I could to do now that the Ender Dragon has been defeated. But then I head a voice - it was sort of like mine, but had an undead accent.)

???: "Where...am I...?"

(I looked to see who it was, but nobody was there.)

[player]: "Who's there?"

(I continued to look around, and finally saw him - he looked a lot like me, except his clothes were tan and covered with dust. His hair was also tan, but his eyes were pitch black.)

[player]: "Wait...you're a Husk!"

Husk: "A what?"
sample.chosen:
Husk: "I don't understand. I was just walking, and then... everything went black. I woke up here, in this... desert. I don't know what a 'Husk' is."

[player]: "A Husk is a type of zombie that only spawns in desert biomes. They're basically zombies that have been dehydrated and mummified by the sun."

Husk: "Zombie? No, I'm not a zombie. I'm... I'm me. I'm... I don't know. I can't remember anything before waking up here."

[player]: "That's strange. I've never heard of a Husk being able to talk, let alone have a consciousness. But I guess there's a first time for everything."

Husk: "What do I do now? I don't know where I am, or what I'm supposed to do."

[player]: "Well, you could come with me. I'm on my way to the nearest village. Maybe someone there can help you figure out who you are."

Husk: "Okay. I don't have anywhere else to go. I'll come with you."

(And so, the player and the talking Husk set off towards the nearest village, hoping to find answers to the Husk's mysterious past.)
